Audio samples from OpenSpades Free Pak and The Free Firearm Sound Library
https://github.com/DeathByDenim/openspades-free-pak/tree/1e6b28721a2e5e51f84a572d101079bf186c66d5
The rifle recording is an edited close AR-15 shot from The Free Firearm Sound Library, described below. Other bundled recordings retain the OpenSpades Free Pak encoding. Volume, pitch, filtering, envelopes and stereo placement are adjusted during playback.

Rifle source and edits:
Source: https://github.com/buddingmonkey/FreeFirearmsSFXLibrary/blob/beb2f4041f3d6740fa0aeaf0e71159bd65a78c1b/Prepared%20SFX/AR-15/D_32P.wav
License: https://github.com/buddingmonkey/FreeFirearmsSFXLibrary/blob/beb2f4041f3d6740fa0aeaf0e71159bd65a78c1b/LICENSE (CC0 1.0 Universal)
Recording identification: Prepared Master Sheet.csv in the same commit identifies D_32P as a near-distance AR-15/M4 gunshot and A_42P as a near-distance 1911 pistol gunshot.
Edits: decode/resample to 44,100 Hz, average left/right to mono, select the first shot from 0.70170068 to 1.08170068 seconds, scale peak to 0.92, apply a 0.5 ms start fade and 55 ms end fade, encode 16-bit PCM WAV. Prepared duration: 0.380 seconds, 33,560 bytes. No synthetic sound is baked into this recording.
Original WAV SHA-256: acee9d2106b68fe5956225a19d7aedf943d97793817f9bda9d486a2b74b0a812
Prepared WAV SHA-256: 9e5426154fb3bb6846828eb0153b77a1fded8128c9edc7ffc5173a93eb3b2d7b
